slides.title: Back-office teams spend 15 minutes per document on manual entry and checks — a bottleneck in finance and procurement
bullets: **32 interviews** with heads of finance operations and procurement (example)
**15 minutes** per contract or invoice: reading, data entry, cross-checks
Cloud document services are not allowed for **confidential** records
Template-based OCR breaks on new layouts: **18% of fields** need rework
Why now: open-weight language models now run on a single on-premise server
slides.source: interviews and time-and-motion data from example pilots; fictional data
slides.notes: State the problem in the customer's words and in measurable units (minutes, share of fields).

slides.title: Solution: a local pipeline “classify → extract → validate → route” instead of manual entry

left.heading: Today
bullets: Manual reading and data entry
Rules break on new templates
Checks against ERP done by hand
Cloud tools blocked by security policy

right.heading: With Velordoc
bullets: About 3 minutes per document
Model adapts to new layouts
Automatic checks against ERP data
Runs inside the customer's network
